_doc: DB10: round-trip ceiling per route the web client calls. trips = X-DB-Trips, wire = statements sent. Lower it when a route gets cheaper (node tests/round-trips-all.test.cjs --write); never raise without saying why. fired:false = placeholder ceiling, the route could not be fired offline (see why). basis:"live from sit-in <date>" = the line is the dearer of the offline stub and round-trips.live.json (a real shop with data); registered_only = a registered route the web does not call, fired too so trips_budgeted can be met. A fired:false line with a 4xx why is a placeholder: the stub only reached a floor and the route needs a live measure.
